text:
maria: Quick sync for Skylark ahead of QBR — onboarding looks on-track but embeddings cost is trending above their forecast. Need a conservative spend slide + enablement plan.
ade: I'll extract the 30/90-day burn and per-route breakdown, 20m.
jordy: Are they still using full-context embeddings for search? Might be overkill.
ops-ryan: Confirmed: default pipeline uses 1536 dims, no downsampling. Also saw a midnight retry surge from their worker that causes short concurrency spikes.
maria: If we propose dimension reduction we should include an AB test and expected quality regressions. Also recommend a retainer cushion in case of bursty retries.
eng-enable: Scheduling two sessions: integration health + prompt/payload hygiene. Propose Wed 4/24 and Thu 5/2. Adding calendar invites.
billing-bot: ALERT: Skylark (acct 82-991) projected next-30d = $12.1k median, $19.4k 90th. Remaining credits: $2.9k.
ade: Raw query I ran: ```SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE acct=82 GROUP BY route ORDER BY tokens DESC;``` Top: chat-api 64%, embed-bulk 29%, other 7%.
jordy: Embed-bulk is the issue. Suggest trial: 1536 (control) vs 512 (treatment), run 7 days, sample 100 queries, evaluate semantic recall on 6 anchors. I can draft the plan.
ops-ryan: Ops note: if they move dims we need a model variant mapping update and to bump a couple of instances for staging. I'll queue that with runtime.
maria: Action items: ade => conservative spend slide (median + 90th + delta). eng-enable => send invites + short prework doc on prompt/payload length. jordy => AB test plan and expected cost delta. ops-ryan => estimate deployment effort for variant mapping. CS => retainer cushion recommendation bullets for execs.
ade: Uploading spend CSV + a quick pivot to drive now: https://redwood.app/drive/skylark/qbr/spend.csv
eng-enable: Prework doc added to invites: "Payload hygiene & retry backoff". Also included a short checklist for truncation and caching hints.
jordy: Draft AB test plan posted in thread: control=1536 dims, treatment=512 dims, run 7 days, N=1000 requests, metrics: P@10 recall, mean reciprocal rank, latency, cost per 1k. Expected cost drop ~40% on embed spend.
maria: For the retainer suggestion include: 1) buffer = max(15% of 90th or remaining credits shortfall) 2) mitigation path (dim AB test + retry rate-limit) 3) timeline to reduce cushion if AB test passes. Need slides by EOD tomorrow.
billing-bot: NOTE: Created draft budget alert rule (80% of proposed retainer) for review: https://redwood.app/alerts/82-991
ade: I'll deliver the 90th percentile slide + per-route table by 5pm PT.
ops-ryan: Added a note: ask their engineers to implement jittered exponential backoff on retries and cap concurrent workers to avoid short-lived burst costs.
maria: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me 1:1. :rocket:
